div.p: You move like a wraith through the killing ground, a specter of death that the jungle itself cannot track. While the others crash through the undergrowth like grox in a china shop, you glide ahead, reading the signs of death, spotting the ambushes before they spring. You have spent more time alone in the deep jungle than most men have spent drawing breath, your soul merged with the darkness itself. You know which plants will poison you, which creatures are hunting you, and which shadows conceal the things that should not exist.

Your squad's lives depend on you. Without your eyes, they would walk blindly into a Catachan Devil's nest and be torn apart. Without your ears, they would miss the sound of something massive and hungry moving in the canopy above. Without your instincts, they would all be dead, their bones picked clean by the jungle's endless hunger. You are the one who finds the paths that do not lead to death, the water that is not tainted, the high ground that offers a moment's respite. You are the one who keeps them alive, for now.
Keep moving. Keep watching. The jungle never sleeps, and neither can you.
Catachan: Rock, Marbo, Arden, Jackson, Straken, Greiss, Ripper, Sly, Nork, Catachan
Choose one for each:
Sharp Eyes, Watchful Eyes, or Hard Eyes
Bandana, Shorn Hair, or Camouflage Paint
Tattered Fatigues, Camouflage Gear, or Light Armor
Lithe Body, Wiry Body, or Scarred Body
Choose a regiment and gain the corresponding move:
When you navigate the jungle through wilderness whatever job you take you succeed as if you rolled a 10+.
When you bivouac in the jungle, you don't need to consume a ration.
You start with these moves:

When you follow a trail of clues left behind by passing creatures, roll+WIS. ✴On a 7+, you follow the creature's trail until there's a significant change in its direction or mode of travel. ✴On a 10+, you also choose 1:

ul.li: Gain a useful bit of information about your quarry, the GM will tell you what
Determine what caused the trail to end

div.p: When you attack a defenseless or surprised enemy at range, you can choose to deal your damage or name your target and roll+DEX.

ul.li: Head ✴10+: As 7–9, plus your damage ✴7-9: They do nothing but stand and drool for a few moments.
Arms ✴10+: As 7-9, plus your damage ✴7-9: They drop anything they're holding.
Legs ✴10+: As 7-9, plus your damage ✴7-9: They're hobbled and slow moving.

div.p: You have an almost supernatural connection with the jungle. You can read its signs, feel its dangers, and know its secrets. Choose a focus:
Tracking, Survival, Navigation, Stealth, Threat Detection
Choose a base:

ul.li: Alertness +2, Instinct +1, +1 to Read the Signs
Alertness +1, Instinct +2, +1 to Read the Signs
Alertness +3, Instinct +1, +1 to Hunt and Track

div.p: Choose as many strengths as your alertness:
Fast, tireless, adaptable, quick reflexes, camouflage, keen senses, stealthy, silent movement
Your jungle sense is trained for specific situations. Choose as many additional trainings as your instinct:
Track, search, scout, guard, identify threats, navigate, survive, evade
Choose as many weaknesses as your instinct:
Paranoid, jumpy, slow, forgetful, stubborn, reckless
When you work with your jungle sense on something it's trained in…

ul.li: …and you attack the same target, add your alertness to your damage
…and you track, add your instinct to your roll
…and you take damage, add your alertness to your armor
…and you read the signs, add your instinct to your roll
…and you negotiate, add your instinct to your roll
…and someone interferes with you, add your alertness to their roll

div.p: Help the squad avoid a deadly threat.
Endanger yourself to eliminate a threat before it attacks.
Complete a mission objective through stealth and reconnaissance.
Your load is 11+Str. You start with rations (5 uses, 1 weight), flak armor (1 armor, 1 weight), and a lascarbine power pack (3 ammo, 1 weight). Choose your armament:

ul.li: Lascarbine (near, far, 1 weight) and Catachan knife (close, 1 weight)
Lascarbine (near, far, 1 weight) and machete (reach, 1 weight)

div.p: Choose one:

ul.li: Field gear (1 weight) and rations (1 weight)
Field gear (1 weight) and lascarbine power pack (3 ammo, 1 weight)

div.p: Fill in the name of one of your companions in at least one:
I have guided _______________ before and they owe me for it.
_______________ trusts my judgment in the jungle, so I will protect them.
_______________ has no respect for the jungle, so I have no respect for them.
_______________ does not understand survival in the wild, so I will teach them.
You may take this move only if it is your first advancement.
You were born and raised in the deepest parts of the Catachan jungle. You gain the Unseen Lurkers starting move if you took the Green Devils one at character creation or vice versa.
When you gain a level from 2-5, choose from these moves.
You can read the signs of the jungle so well that you can predict threats before they appear. When you read the signs about jungle threats, you may ask an additional question.
When you use jungle knowledge about a Catachan creature you use WIS instead of INT.
When you strike an enemy with two weapons at once, add an extra 1d4 damage for your off-hand strike.
When you keep still in natural surroundings, enemies never spot you until you make a movement.

When you use your jungle sense to take a blow that was meant for an ally, the damage is negated but your alertness becomes 0. If your alertness is already 0 you can't use this ability. When you have a few hours of rest your alertness returns to normal.
When you take aim you may spend extra ammo before rolling. For each point of ammo spent you may choose an extra target. Roll once and apply damage to all targets.
Choose another training for your jungle sense.
You've been scouting the jungle for so long that you've learned to read it like a book. When you navigate the jungle, you can take two roles. You make a separate roll for each.
When you set the watch for the night, everyone takes +1 to stand watch.
When you gain a level from 6-10, choose from these moves or the level 2-5 moves.
Replaces: Jungle Whisperer
You can read the signs of the jungle so well that you can predict threats before they appear. When you read the signs about jungle threats, you may ask two additional questions.
Replaces: Familiar Threat
When you use jungle knowledge about a Catachan creature you use WIS instead of INT. On a 12+, in addition to the normal effects, you get to ask the GM any one question about the subject.
Replaces: Dual Strike
When you strike an enemy with two weapons at once, add an extra 1d8 damage for your off-hand strike.
When you know your target's weakest point your shots have 2 piercing.
Replaces: Veteran Scout
When you navigate the jungle you can take two roles. Roll twice and use the better result for both roles.
Replaces: A Safe Place
When you set the watch for the night everyone takes +1 to stand watch. After a night in bivouac when you set the watch everyone takes +1 forward.
When you hunt and track, on a hit you may also ask one question about the creature you are tracking from the read the signs list for free.
Choose a move from another specialization. So long as you are working with your jungle sense you have access to that move.
Your jungle sense has become so attuned that you can sense things that shouldn't be possible. Describe it. Give yourself +2 alertness and +1 instinct, plus a new training.

When you choose to go out in a blaze of glory at death's door, you become one with the jungle one last time, merging your spirit with Catachan itself. You may lead your enemies into a devastating trap, reveal a perfect hidden path to safety, or mark the location of every threat for your allies. Roll+Wis. ✴On a 10+, the jungle itself rises to aid you. You create a perfect escape route or trap that saves all allies and eliminates a major threat. All allies take +2 forward, +2 armor, and enemies take -2 ongoing for the rest of the battle. The jungle remembers you—your allies can read the signs to learn about all threats in the area for the rest of the mission. Your spirit becomes part of Catachan, a permanent guide. Future scouts who know your story take +1 forward when navigating the jungle. ✴On a 7-9, you create an escape route or trap that helps all allies or hinders all enemies. Allies take +1 forward and +1 armor, enemies take -1 ongoing. ✴On a miss, your final act becomes a warning carved into the jungle itself—all allies can read the signs to learn about all threats in the area for the rest of the mission. They take +2 forward and +1 armor. Your spirit becomes part of Catachan, a guide for those who know how to listen. The jungle itself protects those you cared about.
